intro: The EOS coffee table gives you the freedom to style your space your way. Whether showcasing decor or storing essentials, its adaptable design makes every corner look beautifully put together.

features.title: Flexible layout for any space
features.text: Rearrange as you please—our versatile table adapts to various setups, from coffee table to side unit, making it perfect for evolving spaces.

features.title: Access your storage from both sides
features.text: Practical yet stylish—our dual-sided storage helps you maintain a clutter-free home without compromising on aesthetics.

features.title: Clear glass top shows off your display
features.text: Show off your style—the 8mm toughened glass lets you display décor while creating an airy, modern vibe.

features.title: Accessible shelf for everyday items
features.text: Convenient, built-in storage keeps remotes, books, and essentials close by—helping you create a tidy, inviting living space.

features.title: Rich cinnamon finish for warmth
features.text: With its warm cinnamon hue, our design brings instant cosiness to your room. It’s not just furniture—it’s a welcoming touch that makes any space feel more inviting.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
